deviations_from_card: One commit instead of three. flagDrift takes the db handle as an argument (flagDrift(db())), because flags.ts imports nothing from db.ts: db.ts's seed stamps through flags.restamp, and the other way would be a module cycle. flagDrift checks every row, merged and deleted ones included, not only the working list (stricter). The four flags are restamped from their rules over a scope of rows and domains, not per flag: a row whose inputs did not move gets no write. isStaleAt and WORKING moved to flags.ts and are re-exported from db.ts. Case 2 corrupts a row from the phone-format segment, since the seed has no '(415) 555-0134' phone. Case 5 is its own test on a second pair (guard), not part of case 4. domain-lib.test.ts was not changed. guard_cases are 0-based card indexes (summary, undo, refusals).
notes: Premise re-verified after 2a5569b and 4af740b: the hand restamps and the merge with no revision were still there (line numbers had moved). Red before: cases 0,1,2 (lib/flags missing), 3 (no merge revision), 5 (source guard found mutations.ts). Mutation check by hand: taking out the phone, company or resolvePair restamp fails the walk within 20 steps; taking out the last_activity_at feed is covered by merge's closing restamp, so the walk cannot see it. The walk takes about 9 s. Slot B (preview_merge/planMerge) should rebase onto writeField/MERGE_RULE in mergeContacts: adoptions are now writeField calls tagged merge_contacts, and the closing restamp(ids:[keep,drop], domains:[drop.domain]) replaces the hand restamps. ADR 0163 taken under the lock. No sibling reds seen.
